assumptions_challenged: That an MCB/WCB has been produced and characterized for SGL-001
That orthogonal QC panel assays for intact EV have been developed and fit‑for‑purpose validated (LLOQ, specificity, precision, accuracy) for SGL-001
That three GMP-like scale-up runs with release and stability data demonstrating reproducible identity and potency have been completed for SGL-001
That a stability‑indicating potency assay has been developed and correlated to an in vivo PD endpoint for SGL-001
That formulation/device compatibility studies demonstrating intact‑EV recovery ex vivo/in vivo with appropriate controls have been performed for SGL-001
That non-rodent (large-animal) intranasal biodistribution data with orthogonal controls attributing signal to intact EV are available for SGL-001
falsification_conditions: Provision of MCB/WCB establishment and characterization reports for SGL-001 showing source‑cell identity and documented seed‑lot control
Submission of fit‑for‑purpose validation reports for orthogonal intact‑EV assays (including LLOQ, specificity, precision, accuracy) and SOPs for each QC method

Provision of complete records for ≥3 GMP‑like scale‑up batches including in‑process controls, lot‑release data, and accelerated/real‑time stability demonstrating reproducible identity and potency across lots
Demonstration of a stability‑indicating potency assay with documented correlation to an in vivo PD endpoint (reporting assay performance and statistical correlation results)
Provision of formulation and delivery‑device compatibility studies showing intact‑EV recovery and stability ex vivo and in vivo with appropriate negative/orthogonal controls

Provision of non‑rodent intranasal biodistribution/toxicity studies with orthogonal controls that attribute observed signal to intact EV (e.g., separation from free label, non‑vesicular particles, and cell debris)
strongest_objection: The only supplied evidence is the MISEV2023 guidance; it does not include any program-specific CMC, analytical validation, batch, stability, formulation-compatibility, or non-rodent biodistribution data required to justify advancing SGL-001 lots/formulations for cross‑species intact‑EV PK/PD bridging. Therefore the proposed Stage‑1 advancement is not supported by the available evidence set.
